layout.spacing: Generous spacing. p-12, p-16 to p-24 for main sections. Bento grids with gap-6 to gap-8.
layout.grid_modes: Bento grids for features (mix of col-span-2 and col-span-1). Strict asymmetry.
layout.surface_strategy: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-white/[0.03] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]

buttons.primary: bg-[#0047FF] hover:bg-[#003BCC] text-white font-bold px-8 py-4 rounded-full transition-all hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,71,255,0.4)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10 font-bold px-8 py-4 rounded-full transition-all
buttons.accent: bg-[#39FF14] text-black font-extrabold px-8 py-4 rounded-full hover:scale-105 transition-all

cards.glass: bg-white/[0.02] backdrop-blur-lg border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-8 hover:border-[#0047FF]/50 transition-colors group
cards.glow_border: relative before:absolute before:inset-0 before:p-[1px] before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-[#0047FF] before:to-[#39FF14] before:rounded-3xl

waitlist_modal.surface: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-8 max-w-md w-full
waitlist_modal.input: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white placeholder-white/40 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 w-full focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0047FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0047FF]

motion.hover: Fast and punchy. scale-105, duration-200, ease-out.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade up via framer-motion. Initial y: 20, opacity: 0. Spring physics (stiffness 100, damping 20).
motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY. Parallax on hero image.

hero.description: Cinematic athlete starting position with neon blue/green glow
hero.treatment: Use bg-black/40 overlay. Parallax slow scroll.

features_analytics.treatment: Place in Bento grid large cell.

athlete_showcase.description: Athlete in dramatic lighting, night time jump
athlete_showcase.treatment: Use in 'How it Works' or Features section. Rounded corners with electric blue border hover.

athlete_profile.description: Dramatic portrait of athletic man in spotlight
athlete_profile.treatment: Use for testimonial or user profile mockup.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure text uses Barlow Condensed for massive headers and Manrope for body text to give it an elite athletic feel.
Implement waitlist functionality via Shadcn Dialog component but heavily customized with glassmorphism to look premium.
The Hero section must have 'Build Your Athletic Career Digitally' in text-5xl to text-7xl uppercase. The background must use the 'hero' media url with a gradient overlay that keeps it legible.
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use #050505 or #0A0A0A for backgrounds.
All interactive elements must include data-testid.
Split 'Features' visually using a toggle (Athletes vs Recruiters) or a side-by-side bento layout.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide. Provide contrasting neon green (#39FF14) sparingly for 'verified' checkmarks or live dots.
Ensure Lenis is used for smooth momentum scrolling.
Use 1px borders (e.g. border-white/10) instead of heavy shadows for the tactical/athletic feel.
